title: Create a structural brace along a line
task: Place a structural brace along a diagonal Line using Autodesk.Revit.Creation.Document.NewFamilyInstance with a structural framing FamilySymbol, a level and StructuralType.Brace. Covers structural brace modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: A task search 'create a structural brace between two points' does not surface the creation member; top hits are Structure.BracePlanRepresentation and the StructuralType.Brace enum field.
pitfalls.cause: The creation member is Autodesk.Revit.Creation.Document.NewFamilyInstance(Curve, FamilySymbol, Level, StructuralType); its generic name/summary ranks poorly for structural intent (connector issue #341).
pitfalls.fix: Search naming NewFamilyInstance; use the Curve/FamilySymbol/Level/StructuralType overload with StructuralType.Brace on a diagonal Line (braces use the structural framing family).

pitfalls.symptom: NewFamilyInstance creates the brace but it does not render, or an Autodesk exception mentions an inactive symbol.
pitfalls.cause: The FamilySymbol was not activated before use.
pitfalls.fix: Call symbol.Activate() inside the transaction when !symbol.IsActive before NewFamilyInstance.

miss.text: create a structural brace along a diagonal line between two points
